reference.criterion: Full-visual-realism virtual environments displace ordinary text chat rooms.
reference.rationale: Early virtual worlds did not provide full realism or replace mainstream text conversation in 2009. Widely used text-centered collaboration and messaging persist alongside virtual environments. Coexistence is not replacement.
